question: What is the counting range used to begin classifying a mantra for a practitioner?
premises: Mantra classification depends on counting letters.
The count starts from the first letter of one's own name.
The count proceeds to the first letter of the mantra.
inference: The practitioner counts from the first letter of their name up to the first letter of the mantra.
plain_english: From the first letter of one's own name until one reaches the first letter of the mantra.
